translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Félix-asabin Pablo na e-san-bendakega sunmaksad

A-ibataled-sorba, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummad, Ananías-nugadi, Judiomar-girmar-dummagan-abargi Cesarease nonikid, dule-gadi-sunmaked-wargwen, Tértulo-nugad, senonimalad. Wemar bela dummad-neg-dakmaid-asabin nonimalad, adi sogmalagar, Pablo neg-ichodiiye.
Pablo-senonimargu, Tértulo, Pablo neg-ichodiiye sogega, Félixga sogded: “Dummad, ar be dule-binsaed-ibedsoggu, a-ular anmar wegi be-neg-dakmaidgi neg-bogidik, degi, ber neg-nueganbi selemaid.
Dummad-Félix, a-ular bela be-neg-dakmaidgi anmar bela yeer be-abinga-daed, degine, belagwapa anmar dog-nuedye bega sogmarsunnad.
Ar mer budar be-ito-saegala, sikwas ibmar an bega sogoedi, gusgu be ibmar-inikii-saedba bitigi nue be an itosana-gadin.
“Nabir, emide we-dule, dule-iskana-sunnad. Bela Judiomar-we-napneg-naidgi-bukwadse nader, Judiomar-ourwed-duled. Aginbali, Jesús-Nazaretgined-sordamar-e-dummadga gudibalid.
Deginbali, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-siid ichobiguarbalinad. A-ular anmar we-dule-gasmarsunnad, degi, anmar-igar-mamaidba anmar saesokarmalanad.
Degi-inigwele, Roma-sorda-dummad, Lisias-nugadi, anmarse achanonikid, gandikidba anmargi we-dule-sunonikid.

Degine, anmarga soglealid: ‘Bemar we-dulegi sunmakbiele, Dummad-Félixse naer-gebye.’ Aga anmar bese nonimarsunnad. Emidi be-sunnad sunna ese be egised, agi be dakoed, wede anmar egi sunmaknaid, bule nabir anmar egi sognai.”
Judiomar igar-itolenaidgi-bukwamarmogadi sogmarmogad, “Bela Tértulo-ibmar-sogedi nabiridbiye.”
Degi Félix, Pablo-osunmakegala, ese achasad. Degi, Pablo sunmakdegu, sogdesun: “Yeer an itodo be-asabin an na dukin san bendak-sokalid. Ar an wisid, be dikasurgus anmarga neg-semaid.
Ar be-sunnad sunna aimarse be egismogad, wede sana Jerusalénse an noniki. Unnila ibambe-gakabogus Jerusalénse an nonikid, Bab Dummadse golegar, e-nug odummogegar.
Ar dulemarbo abin-abin imaknai gwen an-daksasurmalad, degi, aimar-ourwenai Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Judiomar-onmaked-neggi, degi, neggweburgi gwen an-daksasurmarbalid.
Degisoggu, we-dulemar geg bega sogmalad, emi-angi-sognanaid we nabirye.

“Ar wedi napira an bega sogdo, an-dadgan-Bab-Dummadbardi nue an naid, Jesús-igarba, igar-iskanaye-bimalad, abardi an ibsabalid. Ar ade Bab-Dummad-Gardagi Moisés-igar-mesisad, degi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-narmaksamalad bela an bensulid.

Deginbali, Bab Dummadgi nue an bensulidgi, an edarbedimogad, ar igi wemar Bab Dummad yoedse dulemar-nuegan-burgwismalad, degine, dulemar-iskana-burgwismaladse-bakar gannar durguoye-sogmalad bensulidgii edarbedimogadyob.
Agala, Bab-Dummad-asabin, degi, dulemar-asabin mer bingegugwichi an guegala, an Bab Dummadgi gwen iskubi itodasulid, degisoggu, Bab Dummadgi gwen nodii itolesulid.
“Emide undargus, birga-dikasurgus-bipirmakdid-sorba, an-dulemarse an nonikid, Jerusalénse, dulemar-wileganaga mani ukegar, degi, Bab Dummadga ibmar ukbaligar.
Degi an gunai, igar-maidba an na san-nudaksad-sorba, Judiomar-Asia-yarginmalad Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi an-dakarmalad. Dulemar-bukidar-abargi, degi, an neg-oimaknai amar gwen an-daksasurmalad.
“Dulemar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-an-daksamaladi amar be-asabin gwichi-wilubmalanad, adi angi sunmakmalagar, ibigi nue an nodii an-dakmala.
Ar sulile, wemarse be egisdo, an-dikarba-gwichimaladse, bule nue-nosa an-daksamarmoga, deun Judio-dummagan-igar-nabiromalad-asabin an gwisgusgu.
Unnila amar-abargi an gwichigua, binnasuli an gotegu, an sogde-gusad: ‘Dule-burgwar mair, sunna gannar durguye. Deyob an sogsad-ular, emi-ibagi bemar istar angi sunmakbukmarsunnad.’ ”

Félix, Bab-Jesús-igar bato nue itodisoggu, Pablo wegii ega soge itosgua, Pabloga-igar-itonaid obelossuli meted. Geb degi Pabloga sogde: —Roma-sorda-dummad Lisias-nugad, wese nonikile, agi gannar an bese gormarbaloed.

Degi Félix, Roma-sordamar-dulatar-sediidga igar uksasun, adi Pablo gannar dummad-negse sedega. Degine, ega igar uksabalid, Pablo nabir wis garmakdii imakmaloye, deginbali, sunna e-aimar ese ataknonimarbaloye.
A-ibbigbagwad-sorba, ibagwengine, Félix gannar nonibalid, e-ome-Drusila-ebo. E-omede Judio-duled. Félix Pablose gannar gochabalid. Agine, Jesucristogi-bensuli-guedgi Pablo ega sunmaksad itosii-gusad.

Ar Pablo igar-napiragwadgi, na dukin-san-bargaedgi, degi, Bab-Dummad-yoedse-na-igar-nabirogoedgi ega sunmakargu, Félix dobe-ito-naded, geb degi, Pabloga sokarsunnad: —Emigindi be nagwer, ibagwengi binsa an gudiile, geb an gannar bese gorbaloed.
Félix gannar-gannar Pablo-ebo sunmakega ese gornai-gusad. Ar ade Félix binsaed, Pablo-eskaryagi-mellesiid abakalegi anga mani ukalirye, e-onogegar.
Deyob birgabo gudigusad. Félix dummadga-maid bergusgu, Porcio-Festo e-sorba gan sunonikid. Ar Félix, Judiomar egi nued sunmakegala, yamo Pablo-eskaryagi-mellesiid, eskaryagi-mete obes-naded.
